model.name: vCard drop stores with photo
model.description: Dropping a vCard onto a profile stores the .vcf file alongside the user's avatar photo in the same user directory.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "drop vCard into profile stores .vcf alongside user avatar photo in same user dir."
model.implRef: ior:file:src/public/ts/ProfileEditor.ts:102-139 [impl:uuid:d1337706-80fa-48ba-a0a0-5b9cc42e2511] R21.1 profile.dropVCard | server src/ts/server/server.ts:495-523 [impl:uuid:f15434f9-...] POST /api/vcard storeVCard

acceptanceCriteria.text: A .vcf can be added by drag-drop onto the profile overlay OR via the file picker (accept='.vcf,text/vcard').
A dropped file that is not .vcf / text/vcard is rejected with a 'Please drop a .vcf file' message.
A vCard with none of fn/tel/url/photo is rejected with 'No profile data found' (no empty import).
On valid drop the vCard is parsed (parseVCard) and applyVCard maps photo->avatar, fn->name, plus tel/url into the profile fields.
The photo from the vCard becomes the user avatar (feeds the same avatar pipeline as /api/avatar).
After apply, the client POSTs /api/vcard { playerToken, data:<base64 of the raw .vcf text> } using client.playerToken (not the stale localStorage key).
The server authenticates the playerToken (must be in tokenToClient) and rejects unauthenticated/missing-data/no-profile with 401/400.

The server stores the .vcf in the user's home via encryptFile(playerToken, buf, 'text/vcard', 'contact.vcf', 'vcard') — i.e. as contact.vcf in the SAME user directory and SAME encrypted-file mechanism as the avatar (avatar.<ext>).
On encrypt failure the server rekeys the user and retries the store (no silent loss); success returns { ok:true, vcardUrl:'/api/vcard/<token>' }.

testScenarios.name: drop applies photo+fields
testScenarios.given: a profile overlay and a valid .vcf containing fn, tel, url, photo
testScenarios.then: parseVCard+applyVCard set name=fn, the avatar = the vCard photo, and tel/url populate the profile

testScenarios.name: non-vcf rejected
testScenarios.then: a 'Please drop a .vcf file' error shows and nothing is imported

testScenarios.name: empty vcard rejected
testScenarios.then: 'No profile data found' shows and nothing is applied or stored

testScenarios.name: store POST authenticated
testScenarios.given: an authenticated client with playerToken T
testScenarios.then: POST /api/vcard fires with { playerToken:T, data:base64(text) }; an unauthenticated token gets 401, missing data 400

testScenarios.name: stored as contact.vcf beside avatar
testScenarios.then: contact.vcf exists in the same user directory as avatar.<ext>, written through encryptFile (encrypted at rest)

testScenarios.name: encrypt-failure rekey+retry
testScenarios.then: the server rekeys the user, retries the store, and returns { ok:true, vcardUrl }
